title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 43 (Kinds of Share Capital)

content.overview: Section 43 classifies the share capital of a company limited by shares into equity share capital and preference share capital. Equity is capital that is not preference share capital and may carry voting rights or prescribed differential rights as to dividend, voting or otherwise. Preference share capital carries preferential rights as to dividend and repayment of capital in the circumstances specified by the section.
content.glance: Equity vs preference; differential rights equity under prescribed rules; preferential dividend and capital repayment define preference shares.
content.study: The share capital of a company limited by shares is of two kinds: equity share capital and preference share capital. Equity share capital means all share capital which is not preference share capital, and may have voting rights or differential rights as to dividend, voting or otherwise in accordance with such rules as may be prescribed. Preference share capital means that part of the issued share capital which carries a preferential right with respect to payment of dividend (fixed amount or rate) and preferential right as to repayment of capital in the event of winding up or repayment of capital, in preference to equity. Explanations and provisos address cumulative/non-cumulative features and pre-commencement preference rights. Current-law framing: identify the rights attached to the instrument; classify as equity or preference; if differential-rights equity, test the prescribed rules.

sections.heading: Two Kinds
sections.body: Share capital of a company limited by shares is equity or preference.

sections.heading: Equity Share Capital
sections.body: All capital that is not preference; may carry ordinary voting rights or prescribed differential rights as to dividend, voting or otherwise.

sections.heading: Preference Share Capital
sections.body: Preferential right to dividend (fixed amount or rate) and preferential right to repayment of capital on winding up or repayment, in preference to equity.

sections.heading: Differential Rights
sections.body: Equity with differential rights is valid only within the statutory and rule framework.

examples.title: Ordinary equity
examples.body: Shares with ordinary voting rights and residual dividend rights are equity share capital.

examples.title: Preference classification
examples.body: Shares with a fixed preferential dividend and priority repayment of capital on winding up are preference share capital under s. 43.

examples.title: Differential rights equity
examples.body: A proposed equity class with differential voting rights must satisfy the prescribed rules; s. 43 alone does not validate non-compliant differential rights.

hypotheticals.question: How do you classify shares with fixed preferential dividend and priority capital repayment?
hypotheticals.analysis: They fall within preference share capital under s. 43 when the statutory preferential rights as to dividend and capital are present.

distinctions.title: Kinds of share capital (s. 43) vs nature of shares (s. 44)
distinctions.right: Legal character: movable property transferable per articles

misconceptions.trap: Any share with a higher dividend is automatically preference capital.
misconceptions.correction: Preference status depends on the statutory preferential rights as to dividend and repayment of capital specified in s. 43.

cases.name: Salomon v. A. Salomon & Co. Ltd.
cases.facts: Properly incorporated company challenged as indistinct from controller.
cases.ratioDecidendi: Registered company is a separate legal person.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 43 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify company limited by shares. II. Examine rights attached. III. Classify equity or preference. IV. If differential equity, check prescribed rules. V. Conclude.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What should submissions contain?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Instrument rights; classification under s. 43; differential-rights compliance if claimed; precise relief.

examTips: State both preferential rights for preference capital.
Flag differential-rights equity needs prescribed rules.
